messages:
Tanya (CS): Renewal flag for PolyWrite (multilingual summarization). Customer noticed a 19% token-cost rise and occasional phrase truncation for long Spanish/JP docs. AE asked for low-risk mitigations they can sign off on.
Eli (SE): Do we have language breakdown + seq_len distribution? quantization impact varies by language/decoder tokens.
Sam (RE): Pulled 7d sample: 55% EN, 25% ES, 12% JA, 8% other. Median seq 780, 9% > 2500. Int8 looks promising; int4 might be risky on non-Latin scripts. Recommend int8 for pilot.
Jordan (AE): Customer will only accept changes with clear rollback and language-safety checks. Need a one-page summary and an enablement session for their ops team.
Tanya (CS): Proposed quick plan: 1) Canary int8 for <=1200 seq for EN/ES; route JA & >1200 to standard-fp16. 2) Enable prefix_kv for repeat prefixes. 3) Reserve small dedicated pool during APAC hours (to protect JA heavy traffic). 4) Ask customer for 5 example cases they care about.
Eli (SE): I'll create staging split with language-aware routing. Snippet (staging):
```
route {
  match: path: "/v1/multisummarize"
  condition: "(seq_len <= 1200) && (lang in [\"en\",\"es\"])"
  split: "80/20"
  models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
  fallback: "dedicated-apac-small"
}
route {
  match: path: "/v1/multisummarize"
  condition: "(lang == \"ja\") || (seq_len > 1200)"
  models: ["redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
}
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
batching: { max_batch_ms: 50 }
```
Sam (RE): I'll run fidelity checks on 6k mixed-lang prompts (BLEU, embedding drift, hallucination heuristics) and add per-language buckets. Will flag any JA regressions immediately.
LatencyBot: [monitoring] polywrite-prod token_cost_change=+19% window=2025-12-18T02:00Z->2025-12-18T08:00Z p95=1.05s p99=2.6s
Tanya (CS): Timeline: Eli staging perf (ETA 3h), Sam evals + flagged cases (ETA 6h), Jordan to schedule enablement call + get 5 examples (ETA EOD).
Jordan (AE): I'll set up a 30-min enablement call Mon 10am PT and request their 5 examples. Also will prepare renewal talking points if pilot shows cost savings.
Eli (SE): Will include a dashboard snapshot and a short CSV with p50/p95/p99 + token_cpm delta. Also will test prefix_kv on vs off.
Sam (RE): Early eval note: int8 gives ~18% cost reduction on EN/ES cohorts and median latency -10%. Preliminary quality: 95% of prompts show negligible drift; 6 JA cases flagged for subtle wording loss.
Tanya (CS): Good detail. For customer one-pager include: expected savings, per-language caveats, rollback criteria (any JA critical-case regressions OR >2% CORE metric drop), and pilot opt-in steps. Also include how dedicated APAC fallback protects them.
Jordan (AE): I'll coordinate legal ops sign-off path and confirm we can pause pilot within 1 hour if issues.
Tanya (CS): Action items recap: Eli	staging route & perf (3h), Sam	final evals + examples (6h), Jordan	customer sync + examples (EOD), Tanya	one-pager draft (EOD). Keep thread tight and post blockers here. :thumbsup:
